summary: Program terms are fully documented from the Official Gazette (seven amendments to Art. 20 of the Citizenship Regulation, 2017-2023, all downloaded). Official counts of CBI naturalisations exist only as occasional cumulative ministerial statements (2022, Nov 2024 in a parliamentary transcript, May 2026); no yearly series or application counts are published and parliamentary questions for yearly data have gone unanswered. TurkStat's house sales to foreigners (2013-2025) are a useful proxy; 2025-2026 fraud investigations produced revocation figures (6,134 persons).

observations.quote: An estimated 500,000 foreigners have acquired Turkish citizenship in the last seven years based on figures for real estate purchases.
observations.notes: Estimate linked to the İYİ Party lawsuit (Oct 2024) and derived from property purchase figures, not from naturalisation records. Official figure one month later: 159,433 (TBMM, 20 Nov 2024). Roughly three times the official number.

program_terms.applies_to: main applicant (family included under Law 5901 Art. 12(1)(b))
program_terms.quote: b) En az 1.000.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında taşınmazı tapu kayıtlarına üç yıl satılmaması şerhi koyulmak şartıyla satın aldığı
program_terms.notes: Translation: 'purchased real estate worth at least USD 1,000,000 with a land-registry annotation that it will not be sold for three years'. Value converted at CBRT effective selling rate on the determination date (new para. 6).

program_terms.quote: (b) bendinde yer alan “1.000.000 Amerikan Doları” ibaresi “250.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası” şeklinde
program_terms.notes: USD 250,000 'or equivalent foreign currency or equivalent Turkish lira'; 3-year no-sale annotation retained. From 2018-12-07 also via notarised promise-to-sell contract with full upfront payment (tur-rg-2018-12-07-reg).

program_terms.quote: kat mülkiyeti ya da kat irtifakı kurulmuş, en az 250.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası tutarı peşin olarak yatırılan taşınmazın satışının vaat edildiğine dair noterden düzenlenen sözleşmenin üç yıl süreyle devri ve terkini yapılmayacağı taahhüdüyle tapu siciline şerh edildiği
program_terms.notes: Pre-sale route: notarised promise-to-sell contract for a unit under condominium/construction servitude, full amount paid upfront, 3-year non-transfer undertaking annotated. Threshold follows the real-estate route afterwards (250,000 to 2022-06-12; 400,000 from 2022-06-13).

program_terms.quote: b) En az 250.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz tutarındaki taşınmazı tapu kayıtlarına üç yıl satılmaması şerhi koyulmak şartıyla satın aldığı
program_terms.notes: TL equivalent no longer accepted; the foreign currency must be sold to a bank in Turkey and by it to the Central Bank before the transaction (new para. 10).

program_terms.quote: (b) bendinde yer alan “250.000” ibareleri “400.000” şeklinde değiştirilmiştir. ... a) 1 inci maddesi yayımından 1 ay sonra
program_terms.notes: Decree published 13 May 2022; the threshold change entered into force one month after publication. USD or equivalent FX, sold to the Central Bank via a bank.

program_terms.quote: “döviz tutarındaki kat mülkiyeti veya kat irtifakı kurulmuş ya da üzerinde yapı bulunan arsa vasıflı taşınmazı” şeklinde değiştirilmiştir
program_terms.notes: Only units under condominium/construction servitude, or plots with a building on them; agricultural land and empty plots excluded. Since 01/03/2024 value must be confirmed by a GEDAŞ valuation report (TKGM circular 2024/2; tur-tkgm-ykt-degerleme-raporu). Still in force per consolidated text read 2026-09-28.

program_terms.quote: a) En az 2.000.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında sabit sermaye yatırımı gerçekleştirdiği Ekonomi Bakanlığınca tespit edilen
program_terms.notes: Certified by the Ministry of Economy.

program_terms.quote: (a) bendinde yer alan “2.000.000 Amerikan Doları”, “Ekonomi Bakanlığınca” ibareleri sırasıyla “500.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası”
program_terms.notes: TL equivalent removed from 2022-01-06 (tur-rg-2022-01-06-reg). Certified by the Ministry of Industry and Technology.

program_terms.quote: c) En az 100 kişilik istihdam oluşturduğu
program_terms.notes: Not a monetary amount: minimum number of jobs created.

program_terms.quote: (c) bendinde yer alan “100”, Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığınca” ibareleri sırasıyla, “50”
ç) En az 3.000.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında mevduatı üç yıl tutma şartıyla Türkiye'de faaliyet gösteren bankalara yatırdığı
(ç) bendinde yer alan “3.000.000 Amerikan Doları” ibaresi “500.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası”
program_terms.notes: Held 3 years. From 2022-01-06 the FX must be sold to the Central Bank and the deposit held in Turkish lira for 3 years (tur-rg-2022-01-06-reg, para. 10).

program_terms.quote: d) En az 3.000.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında Devlet borçlanma araçlarını üç yıl tutmak şartıyla satın aldığı
(d) bendinde yer alan “3.000.000 Amerikan Doları”, “Hazine Müsteşarlığınca” ibareleri sırasıyla “500.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası”
program_terms.notes: Held 3 years. From 2022-01-06 held as TL-denominated government debt after FX sale to the Central Bank.

program_terms.quote: e) En az 1.500.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında gayrimenkul yatırım fonu katılma payı veya girişim sermayesi yatırım fonu katılma payı aldığı ve üç yıl süre ile elinde tuttuğu
program_terms.notes: Real estate investment fund or venture capital fund units, held 3 years; certified by the Capital Markets Board.

program_terms.quote: (e) bendi “En az 500.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası tutarında gayrimenkul yatırım fonu katılma payı veya girişim sermayesi yatırım fonu katılma payını en az üç yıl elinde tutma şartıyla satın aldığı

f) En az 500.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz tutarında katkı payını, kapsamı Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu tarafından belirlenen fonlarda tutma ve üç yıl sistemde kalma şartıyla bireysel emeklilik sistemine yatırdığı
program_terms.notes: Contribution to the private pension system held 3 years; converted to TL via the Central Bank.

events.title: Legal basis for investor naturalisation
events.description: Law 6735 (International Labour Force) amends Citizenship Law 5901 Art. 12(1) to allow exceptional naturalisation of investor-type residence permit holders and Turquoise Card holders and their families.
events.quote: 5901 sayılı Türk Vatandaşlığı Kanununun 12 nci maddesinin birinci fıkrasına (a) bendinden sonra gelmek üzere aşağıdaki bent eklenmiş

events.title: Citizenship by investment launched
events.description: Regulation amendment 2016/9601 creates five investment routes, including USD 1m real estate held 3 years.
events.quote: MADDE 2- Bu Yönetmelik yayımı tarihinde yürürlüğe girer.

events.title: Investment fund route added (USD 1.5m)
events.description: Real estate / venture capital fund units of USD 1.5m held 3 years become a qualifying route.
events.quote: En az 1.500.000 Amerikan Doları tutarında gayrimenkul yatırım fonu katılma payı

events.title: Thresholds cut: real estate to USD 250,000
events.description: Presidential Decree 106 lowers real estate to USD 250,000, capital/deposit/bond/fund routes to USD 500,000 and jobs to 50; TL equivalents allowed; switching between routes allowed.
events.quote: “1.000.000 Amerikan Doları” ibaresi “250.000 Amerikan Doları veya karşılığı döviz ya da karşılığı Türk Lirası” şeklinde

events.title: Off-plan / promise-to-sell contracts accepted
events.description: Presidential Decree 418 lets a notarised promise-to-sell contract with full upfront payment qualify under the real estate route.
events.quote: noterden düzenlenen sözleşmenin üç yıl süreyle devri ve terkini yapılmayacağı taahhüdüyle tapu siciline şerh edildiği

events.title: Foreign currency must be sold to the Central Bank; TL no longer accepted
events.description: Presidential Decree 5072 removes TL equivalents and requires investors' foreign currency to be sold to a bank and on to the Central Bank before the transaction.
events.quote: döviz tutarları işlem öncesinde Türkiye’de faaliyet gösteren bir bankaya ve bu bankaca da Merkez Bankasına satılır

events.title: Real estate threshold raised to USD 400,000 (from 13 June 2022); pension route added
events.description: Presidential Decree 5554 raises the real estate minimum from 250,000 to 400,000, effective one month after publication, and adds a USD 500,000 private pension route.
events.quote: (b) bendinde yer alan “250.000” ibareleri “400.000” şeklinde değiştirilmiştir.

events.title: Only built property qualifies
events.description: Presidential Decree 7938 restricts the real estate route to condominium units or plots with buildings; farmland and empty plots excluded.
events.quote: kat mülkiyeti veya kat irtifakı kurulmuş ya da üzerinde yapı bulunan arsa vasıflı taşınmazı

events.title: Valuation reports for CBI centralised at state-linked appraiser
events.description: TKGM circular 2024/2: valuation reports underlying citizenship applications are issued by GEDAŞ through the TADEBİS system (Tutar Tespit Belgesi, valid six months). Media describe GEDAŞ as a TOKİ affiliate (tur-kronos-2026-08-08).
events.quote: 01/03/2024 tarihinde yürürlüğe giren Yabancıların Taşınmaz Edinimlerinde ve Bazı İşlemlerde Kullanılacak Değerleme Raporlarına İlişkin Usul ve Esaslar hakkındaki 2024/2 Sayılı Genelge

events.title: Opposition İYİ Party sues to revoke naturalisations
events.description: İYİ Party petitions the Council of State to revoke citizenship of about half a million naturalised foreigners, mainly Syrians, arguing a national security risk; it estimates 500,000 CBI naturalisations.

events.title: First official cumulative CBI numbers disclosed in parliament
events.description: Interior Minister Yerlikaya tells the Plan and Budget Committee, 'for the first time', that 159,433 people (46,163 investors) have been naturalised through investment.
events.quote: ilk defa söylüyorum: 159.433 yabancı yatırım yaparak, istisnai olarak Türk vatandaşlığını kazanmıştır

events.title: Operation against sham property sales for citizenship (19 provinces)
events.description: Police operation in 19 provinces against 117 suspects accused of arranging sham property sales so that 451 foreigners and their families could obtain citizenship; 49 arrested; citizenship of 451 foreigners withdrawn (per the Interior Minister).
events.quote: 19 ilde eş zamanlı bir operasyon düzenledik 24/9/2025'te.

events.title: Ministry declines to give yearly CBI naturalisation figures to parliament
events.description: CHP MP Murat Bakan records that four written questions since 2023 asking for yearly CBI naturalisations by nationality were answered only with a reference to the legislation.
events.quote: bugüne kadar bu konuyla ilgili sorduğum tüm sorularım yanıtsız bırakılmıştır

events.title: Interior Minister gives updated total: 174,567 people since 2018
events.description: Minister Mustafa Çiftçi: 51,762 investors and 122,805 family members naturalised; USD 16.074bn of investment.
events.location: section '174 bin kişiye yatırım karşılığı vatandaşlık'
events.quote: toplam 174 bin 567 kişi bu kapsamda Türk vatandaşlığı kazanmıştır

events.title: Istanbul operation on fake valuation reports (first wave)
events.description: Operation in 16 provinces against 90 suspects (72 detained) over sham sales of low-value property backed by inflated valuation reports; 687 people found to have obtained citizenship irregularly (Babacan İnşaat-linked sales).
events.quote: Bu yolla 687 kişinin usulsüz vatandaşlık kazandığı açıklandı.

events.title: Ministry announces 6,134 CBI citizenships annulled or withdrawn
events.description: Interior Ministry: 1,150 investors' investment certificates cancelled after fake/irregular valuation reports (5,391 persons' citizenship annulled) and 263 investors (743 persons) withdrawn on security grounds.
events.quote: toplamda 1413 yatırımcı ve aile fertleri ile birlikte 6 bin 134 kişinin vatandaşlık kazanma kararı

events.title: Second wave: 274 sham sales, 1,070 irregular citizenships
events.description: Istanbul prosecutors: 274 of 734 sales to foreigners by three construction firms were sham; 1,070 persons naturalised irregularly; USD 72.25m of required FX never entered; 88 suspects, 72 detained, 2,011 properties frozen, 30 companies placed under trustees.
events.quote: 274 satış işleminin muvazaalı olduğu tespit edilmiştir

programs.name: Turkish citizenship by investment (Türk Vatandaşlığı Kanununun Uygulanmasına İlişkin Yönetmelik, Art. 20(2))
programs.notes: Exceptional naturalisation under Law 5901 Art. 12(1)(b) by presidential decision (Council of Ministers until Sept 2018). Routes: real estate, fixed capital, jobs, bank deposit, government bonds, investment funds, private pension (from 2022). Certifying bodies: TKGM/Ministry of Environment (real estate), Ministry of Industry, Ministry of Labour, BDDK, Treasury, SPK, SEDDK. Security vetting by police and MİT; decision prepared by the DG of Population and Citizenship Affairs.

new_indicators.name: Dwellings sold to foreigners (proxy)
new_indicators.definition: Number of dwellings sold to foreign nationals in a period, from land-registry data. A context/proxy series, not a count of CBI applicants or purchases.
new_indicators.notes: Turkey: TurkStat from TKGM; excludes persons of Turkish origin and those under Law 4112.

new_indicators.name: Dependants granted citizenship
new_indicators.definition: Family members (spouses, children, other dependants) naturalised through the program in a period, excluding main applicants

new_indicators.name: Spouses granted citizenship
new_indicators.definition: Spouses of main applicants naturalised through the program

new_indicators.name: Children granted citizenship
new_indicators.definition: Children of main applicants naturalised through the program

new_indicators.name: Program citizenships revoked
new_indicators.definition: Persons (main applicants plus dependants unless noted) whose program citizenship was annulled or withdrawn

new_indicators.name: Main applicants whose program citizenship was revoked
new_indicators.definition: Main applicants (investors) whose citizenship or qualifying investment certificate was annulled or withdrawn

new_indicators.name: Irregular naturalisations detected
new_indicators.definition: Persons found by prosecutors or authorities to have obtained program citizenship irregularly (e.g. via sham sales or inflated valuations), whether or not yet revoked

new_indicators.name: Investment eligibility certificates issued
new_indicators.definition: Main applicants who obtained (or became entitled to) the certificate confirming a qualifying investment, a step before the citizenship decision

new_indicators.name: Properties acquired for citizenship
new_indicators.definition: Number of real estate units bought under the program's real estate route

new_indicators.name: Applications pending
new_indicators.definition: Applications awaiting a decision at a point in time

gaps: No official yearly series of CBI naturalisations or applications; the Interior Ministry has declined parliamentary requests for yearly figures by nationality (tur-tbmm-bakan-q-2025-09). Only cumulative totals exist: 25,969 'investors' (May 2022), 159,433 persons / 46,163 investors (Nov 2024), 174,567 / 51,762 (May 2026).
No breakdown by route (real estate vs deposits etc.) or by nationality from an official source.
Çiftçi's 29 May 2026 statement found only in secondary media (Kronos, Turizm Ekonomi citing DW Türkçe); original interview not located. T24 and Gazete Duvar pages blocked automated access.
The TBMM answer of the Ministry of Environment to MP Erkan Aydın (2021; 19,630 persons / 30,358 properties) not retrieved; only the press report.
The Interior Ministry's revocation statements were read only in newspaper reproductions; icisleri.gov.tr did not carry them.

Inconsistency not resolved: cumulative revocations unchanged at 6,134 between 4 Aug and 21 Sep 2026 while the since-11-Feb subset rose from 1,358 to 1,393; unclear whether the 451 withdrawn after the Sept 2025 operation and the 1,070 from the Sept 2026 wave are included.
Soylu's 2022 figure (25,969 'yabancı yatırımcı') is ambiguous: investors vs persons, approvals vs naturalisations.
TKGM guide (Kılavuz, 09/12/2024) and circulars 2024/2 and 2024/4 could not be downloaded (tkgm.gov.tr file links now return the new site's HTML shell).
Monthly/annual TKGM counts of properties bought for citizenship (Your Key Türkiye 'İstatistikler' page) render via JavaScript; not captured.
No archive.org snapshots were found for the media URLs (Wayback availability API returned none); archive before merge.
No fiscal revenue figure: CBI money mostly goes to private sellers/banks; the USD 16.074bn and 7.53bn figures are gross 'investment' claims.
leads: TBMM written question answers, 27th term: Erkan Aydın (CHP Bursa) question to the Ministry of Environment and Urbanisation, answered ~Oct 2021 (search https://www.tbmm.gov.tr/denetim/yazili-soru-onergeleri; results load via JavaScript).
Murat Bakan's earlier questions 7/741 (answered without numbers), 7/6557, 7/18414, 7/25922, 7/32748 (28th term).

DW Türkçe article by Alican Uludağ (2026) on 174,567 figure; T24 'Türkiye'de kaç yabancı yatırım yoluyla vatandaşlık aldı?' https://t24.com.tr/gundem/turkiyede-kac-yabanci-yatirim-yoluyla-vatandaslik-aldi,1340815 (403 to bots).
TurkStat nationality table 'Ülke Uyruklarına Göre Yabancılara Yapılan Konut Satış Sayıları' on the same bulletin page (Iranian, Iraqi, Russian buyers) for a nationality proxy.
Academic: 'Citizenship by investment in Turkey: Who buys citizenship and why?', Southeast European and Black Sea Studies 25(2), doi:10.1080/14683857.2023.2255025 (cites Soylu 2022 statement).

Bilkent University thesis 'Yatırım yoluyla vatandaşlık kazanılması: problemler ve çözüm önerileri' https://repository.bilkent.edu.tr/server/api/core/bitstreams/9f6c0c30-bf66-4c2a-8db9-1bc2e5512c7e/content
